{{Quote|Many humans will try an' tell ye there ain't no such thing as the surface o' Bespin, an' technically they be right -- that's why Boss Ugnor decided the planet needed one. Usin' leftover materials from the construction project floatin' overhead, materials given freely by a grateful Baron Figg, Boss Ugnor led thousands of Ugnaughts in a second massive construction project. An' as ye can see, the Surface has evolved o'er time, just as any landscape would.|[[Ars Fivvle]]|<ref name="Bespin: Action Tidings">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref>}}
The '''Ugnaught Surface''' was the name of the artificial [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] colony built in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], just one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] below the main colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==Characteristics==
The Ugnaught Surface measured approximately one square kilometer in surface area and contained artificial swamps, marshes, and jungles that were reminiscent of [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]]. No herbivores or large predators were known to inhabit the Surface, but a crashed ship had brought in stinging [[nank fly]]s.<ref name="ActionTidings2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}}</ref>

Many sections of the internal [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] structure were exposed to the elements due to rough weather and [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircar]] collisions, with some girders repurposed to become tourist walkways.<ref name="CSWE" />

The Surface remained stable and floating at an ideal altitude thanks to a large set of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]]-filled bladders.<ref name="CSWE" /> Its bowl-shaped structure allowed condensing moisture to be collected from Bespin's atmosphere, which could then be used to feed the artificial landscapes.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />

==History==
The city was originally the vision of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ugnor]], a popular Ugnaught leader that had helped [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] build Cloud City. Using donated, left-over materials from the construction of Ecclessis Figg's city, the Surface was used as a base, where Ugnaughts could [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and minerals used to construct the Cloud City facility. Later on, it became somewhat a place for tourists overflowing from the crowds on Cloud City after the fall of the Empire.<ref name="CSWE" />

While the population was constantly changing, the Surface generally held between 10,000 to 20,000 Ugnaughts, not counting visitors.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />

When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] took over as [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of Cloud City, he promised to double the wages of Ugnaught miners, provided that any tibanna refining on the Surface ended.<ref name="ActionTidings3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041014bespin3|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 3: The High Human o' Cloud City}}</ref>
